goal: Triage compact modular castle candidate before normal-game integration
observations: V2 concept has cream keep and wings but weak open court hierarchy. New source candidate has three real masses 10.5/7/5.5m, hipped russet roofs, real arched gate void, continuous 14x10m foundation, open east music-court exit.
This is a project design inferred from existing Oskar modular massing research, not the author private generator. GPU visual and full gameplay navigation remain untested.
